summary: Iter-38 frontend-only verification of the JobStonesTable / jobStatuses consolidation. The public preview URL (lab-traceability.preview.emergentagent.com) still serves the Emergent 'Not Found' webflow page (asleep / deprovisioned, same blocker as iter-36/37). Worked around by Playwright-routing /api/** in the browser to localhost:8001 after seeding sessionStorage with a real admin token. End-to-end verified on /dashboard/jobs against job #584 (2 stones, draft, Parcel of 3 badge). Code review of the refactor matches the spec exactly: JobStonesTable.tsx exposes both 'compact' and 'full' variants, owns cert-grouping with sorted (cert#-asc) navy header rows, and gates checkboxes/fee/status badges/cert-scan/delete behind the 'full' variant + appropriate props. jobStatuses.ts exports JOB_STATUSES (8) and JOB_STATUSES_WITH_CANCEL (9). Jobs page (page.tsx:1650) passes variant='full' + selectedStones + onToggleStone + onOpenStone + onViewCertScan + onDeleteStone + editMode + isAdmin (all 8 props per spec). Shipments dialog (JobDetailDialog.tsx:237) passes variant='compact' + onOpenStone only and uses JOB_STATUSES (8 entries, no Cancelled) per spec. job-activity-list still renders at the bottom of the /jobs dialog. NO regressions detected. Build artefacts present at /app/frontend/build/dashboard/{jobs,shipments}/index.html.
action_items: Wake the preview env so the next browser run can hit the public URL directly. Same advice as iter-37.

(Low-priority observation, not introduced by this refactor) /dashboard/jobs dialog shows 4 delete-stone buttons for a 2-stone job in edit mode — duplication is likely the mobile-breakpoint card view also rendering deletes. The refactor only consolidated the desktop md:block table, so this pre-dates iter-38. Worth confirming the mobile stone cards weren't also expected to use JobStonesTable.
critical_code_review_comments: JobStonesTable.tsx colCount math (lines 111-114) correctly tracks SKU/Type/Weight/Shape/Value/Certificate (6) + Fee (full) + select (full+onToggle) + delete (full+edit+admin+onDelete). The cert-group <TableCell colSpan={colCount}> header therefore aligns across all variant combinations — LGTM.

JobStonesTable.tsx getCertificateLabel is imported from /app/dashboard/jobs/_helpers — that's a cross-route import from a shared component into a route-private _helpers folder. Works fine because Next is import-graph-based, but flagging it as a smell: when this component is reused from /shipments it now silently couples to /jobs internals. Consider moving getCertificateLabel into /lib alongside jobStatuses.ts.

JobStonesTable.tsx lines 162-189: the cert-scan button is rendered inline inside the Certificate cell only for full+certificate_scan_url+onViewCertScan. Compact variant always shows '-' or the Cert badge — matches spec ('NO cert-scan FileText icon' on shipments side).

JobStonesTable.tsx StoneStatusBadges cast on line 148 uses `stone as unknown as Parameters<typeof StoneStatusBadges>[0]['stone']` — pragmatic but loose. As `cancelled`, `stone_status`, `cert_status` are all optional on StonesTableStone, this is safe today; a future required field added to the badges' Stone type would silently start crashing only the /shipments side (since /jobs is the one that already has full Stone shape).

jobStatuses.ts JOB_STATUSES_WITH_CANCEL is built with `[...JOB_STATUSES, ['cancelled','Cancelled']]` — verified 9 options render in the live edit-status-select dropdown in the exact order: Draft, Stones Accepted, Sent to Lab, Verbal Uploaded, Stones Returned, Cert. Uploaded, Cert. Returned, Done, Cancelled.

shipments/_components/JobDetailDialog.tsx line 68 reassigns JOB_STATUSES to a local const JOB_STATUSES_LOCAL — harmless re-aliasing, but the variable is now dead-code-equivalent. Could just `JOB_STATUSES.map(...)` directly to drop one line.
